@js: var es=Array.isArray(result)?result:[result];var b=String(baseUrl).match(/[?&]book_id=([0-9]+)/);var out=[];var allowed={};for(var i=0;i<es.length;i++){var e=es[i];if(e && /^[0-9]+$/.test(String(e.id)) && String(e.title||'').trim() && (String(e.is_vip)==='0' || String(e.is_vip)==='1')){out.push(e);if(String(e.is_vip)==='0')allowed[String(e.id)]=true;}}book.putVariable('readerQimaoFreeChapters',JSON.stringify({bookId:b?b[1]:'',chapters:allowed}));out;

ruleContent.content: @js: var safe=false;try{var g=JSON.parse(String(book.getVariable('readerQimaoFreeChapters')||'{}'));var m=String(baseUrl).match(new RegExp('^https://www[.]qimao[.]com/shuku/([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)/$'));safe=!!(m && g.bookId===m[1] && g.chapters && g.chapters[m[2]]===true);}catch(e){}var es=java.getElements('.chapter-detail-article');if(safe && es.size()>0){var c=es.get(0).clone();c.select('script,style,iframe').remove();c.html();}else{'';}

ruleToc.chapterList: @js: var es=java.getElements('.catalog-cnt .chapter-list li > a'); var out=[]; var allowed={}; var b=String(baseUrl).match(new RegExp('^https://book[.]zhulang[.]com/([0-9]+)/')); for(var i=0;i<es.size();i++){var e=es.get(i); var u=String(e.attr('href')); var m=u.match(new RegExp('^https://book[.]zhulang[.]com/([0-9]+)/([0-9]+)[.]html$')); if(b && m && m[1]===b[1]){var title=String(e.text()).trim(); var vip=/\[vip\]/i.test(title); if(title){out.push({url:u,title:title,isVip:vip});if(!vip)allowed[m[2]]=true;}}} book.putVariable('readerZhulangFreeChapters',JSON.stringify({bookId:b?b[1]:'',chapters:allowed})); out;

ruleToc.chapterList: @js: var b=String(baseUrl).match(new RegExp('^https://www[.]kujiang[.]com/book/([0-9]+)/catalog')); var out=[]; var allowed={}; var ds=java.getElements('.kjsection-catalog dl'); for(var i=0;i<ds.size();i++){var d=ds.get(i); var dt=String(d.select('dt').text()).trim(); var sectionVip=/VIP/i.test(dt); var as=d.select('dd a[href]'); var rows=[]; for(var j=0;j<as.size();j++){var a=as.get(j); var m=String(a.attr('href')).match(new RegExp('^/book/([0-9]+)/([0-9]+)$')); var title=String(a.text()).trim(); if(b && m && m[1]===b[1] && title){var vip=sectionVip || a.hasClass('vip');rows.push({url:'https://m.kujiang.com/book/'+m[1]+'/'+m[2],title:title,isVip:vip,isVolume:false});if(!vip)allowed[m[2]]=true;}} if(rows.length){if(dt)out.push({url:'',title:dt,isVip:false,isVolume:true});for(var j=0;j<rows.length;j++)out.push(rows[j]);}} book.putVariable('readerKujiangFreeChapters',JSON.stringify({bookId:b?b[1]:'',chapters:allowed})); out;
